articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: US Stock Market Today: S&P 500 Futures Rise As Inflation Worries Ease. The Morning Bull - US Market Morning Update Monday, Feb, 16 2026 US stock futures are pointing higher this morning, with benchmark contracts on the S&P 500, Dow and Nasdaq all in the green, as investors react to softer January inflation. Headline US CPI sits at 2.4% with core CPI at 2.5%, which means the cost of living is still rising but now closer to the Federal Reserve’s comfort zone.
